ruleDefinitions.name: Whoami.EXE Execution Anomaly
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of whoami.exe with suspicious parent processes.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "whoami\.exe") AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) OR parent_process_path = "None" OR (parent_process_path = "" OR parent_process_path = "\-")) AND  NOT (parent_process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Monitoring\\ Agent\\\\Agent\\\\MonitoringHost\\\.exe$"))
